scope: durable cancellation through Runtime Worker scheduler and executeTeamTask
flow: Runtime Worker scheduler claims a Team task and starts fenced executeTeamTask.
The test host records active child work and calls durable journal requestCancel.
Scheduler observes cancelRequested and aborts the executor signal.
Team Run waits stop and executeTeamTask maps AbortError to team_task_cancel_requested.
No final main Turn is submitted; already-created child Runs are explicitly cleaned up.
limitations: Cancellation does not undo an already dispatched external side effect.
The tested actor/authorization host is explicit test composition, not the default desktop production path.
OS kill plus cancellation plus unknown external side effects still require a later combined production-host audit.
